content:
**Easy Target**, formerly **Shotgunner**, is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Increased ranged damage to crippled enemies.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | +75% ranged damage to crippled targets. | 00127855 | 
| ★★ | 2 | +50% ranged damage to crippled targets. | 00090694 | 
| ★ | 1 | +25% ranged damage to crippled targets. | 00090590 | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Shotgunner." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to shotguns.
